name: qc-individual-return
description: Quebec personal income tax return (TP-1, filed with Revenu Québec) for an individual resident in Quebec on 31 December, tax year 2026, with a dated section of full 2025 figures for the return being filed now. Covers the four Quebec brackets, the basic personal amount and main non-refundable credits at 14%, the worker deduction, QPP and QPIP for employees and the self-employed (Schedules U and R, line 248 deduction), the health services fund contribution (Schedule F, line 446), the drug insurance premium, deadlines, instalments, penalties and interest, and the 16.5% Quebec abatement on the federal T1. Trigger on "Quebec tax", "TP-1", "Revenu Québec", "impôt du Québec", "QPP self-employed", "RQAP", "FSS line 446", "Quebec abatement". Out of scope: the federal T1 computation (ca-fed-t1-return), CPP and EI (ca-fed-cpp-ei), business income rules (ca-fed-t2125), QST (qc-qst-return), employer payroll (qc-employer-contributions), companies (qc-corporate-tax-co17).
